REMOVAL OF REAR DRIVE SHAFT

1. JACK UP AND SUPPORT VEHICLE

2. REMOVE WHEEL

RA0912

3. DISCONNECT REAR DRIVE SHAFT FROM DIFFERENTIAL

(a) Using a jack, raise the No. 2 suspension arm until it is horizontal.

(b) Place the matchmarks to the rear drive shaft and side gear shaft flange.

(c) Remove the six nuts, while depressing the brake pedal.
